company.description: Tag Ventures aims to be the go-to facilitator for technology-driven companies across a wide range of markets, including Healthcare, Education, Retail/Consumer, Real Estate, Hospitality, and Food & Agriculture. The firm is stage-agnostic and works with everyone from early-stage companies looking to raise as little as $500,000 to established companies valued at north of $100 million.
